source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
Errata replacing the [For the Greater Good](vsdata:ability/tau-empire.for-the-greater-good) army rule. With a **T'AU EMPIRE** Army Faction, as your [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase) starts you may make units of yours that have this ability Observers.

In that Shooting phase:

- Each Observer that is **eligible to shoot** and not yet **selected to shoot** tags 1 **visible** enemy unit as its Spotted unit until the phase ends.
- **Battle-shocked** and **FORTIFICATION** units cannot tag.
- Each enemy unit can be Spotted only once per phase.
- Your units with [For the Greater Good](vsdata:ability/tau-empire.for-the-greater-good) that are not Observers are Guided while targeting at least 1 Spotted unit.

Until the phase ends, each attack a Guided unit's model makes against a Spotted unit:

- improves its Ballistic Skill by 1
- has **[[IGNORES COVER]](vsdata:weapon-ability/ignores-cover)** if an Observer with the Markerlight keyword did the spotting
